## Verification boundary

Expiry is a maintenance deadline, not an announced Roblox release or removal date. Checks fail on the expiry date, missing evidence, unresolved sources, or changed pins. Passing checks establishes consistency with the cited snapshot; it does not prove Studio, multi-client, live-server, or production behavior.
